edition.notes: The 1859 translation is public domain and is not part of the ANF or NPNF corpora. A dated Tertullian Project delivery has been registered for sermons 110-123; that host modernizes the English and interleaves printed page markers, so its exact delivery is kept distinct from the 1859 print.
edition.title: A Commentary upon the Gospel according to S. Luke, by S. Cyril, Patriarch of Alexandria, translated from a Syriac manuscript

passages.context: Sermon 120 and its Luke 18:9-14 lemma were checked in the surrounding sermon sequence. Cyril contrasts the Pharisee's boastful comparison with the publican's embodied confession and petition, and locates justification in God's judgment rather than self-assessment.
passages.notes: The English witness derives from Payne Smith's Syriac-based translation supplemented from Greek catena fragments; it is not represented as a complete Greek textual control.
passages.reason: The rights record states that lawful project access to this artifact does not include redistribution from this repository.

alternate_titles: Homilies on the Gospel of Saint Luke
work.author: Cyril of Alexandria
work.description: Cyril of Alexandria's homiletic commentary on Luke, surviving substantially in a Syriac version and partly in Greek catena fragments. It is conventionally cited by sermon number; sermons 4 and 5 treat the Presentation in the Temple and the finding of the boy Jesus.
work.title: Commentary on the Gospel of Saint Luke
